faq.question: Is a Master’s in Chemical Engineering available in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius lists a BEng (Hons) Chemical Engineering at undergraduate level, but a dedicated Master’s in Chemical Engineering does not appear in its published 2026–2027 postgraduate programme list. Students searching for Master’s in Chemical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students should check related postgraduate options and confirm future programme availability directly with the university.

faq.question: Which related master’s programme can I consider?
faq.answer: The MSc Sustainable Energy Engineering with Environmental Management at the University of Mauritius may be worth exploring if your interests include energy systems and environmental sustainability. It is not the same qualification as a Master’s in Chemical Engineering.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Mauritius as a student?
faq.answer: For initial planning, estimate around MUR 15,000–25,000 per month, or approximately ₹30,000–₹50,000 using the illustrative exchange rate in this article. Personal expenses may differ.

faq.question: Can Indian students apply for engineering-related postgraduate courses in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Indian applicants can enquire about international admission, but eligibility, accepted qualifications, fees and any study-permit requirements depend on the institution and chosen course. Confirm these details before applying.

faq.question: What jobs can I pursue after a related postgraduate qualification?
faq.answer: Depending on your course and experience, you may explore process engineering, production, quality assurance, environmental management, energy sustainability or research roles. Check that the curriculum provides the technical preparation required for your chosen career. Edu-Hawk Worldwide can support students exploring international education opportunities and help them understand programme selection, eligibility and application requirements.
